description: Deny-list for rendered text in the F1 fidelity harness. It covers locked-rule violations (certification/verification/score/compliance/tamper-proof/ledger), public-report PII (full VIN, plate, email, phone, GPS, PSI) and the deferred certification/score vocabulary. Extend only with an owner decision recorded in docs/ui/figma/decisions.md.

patterns.name: full-vin-17-chars
patterns.note: VIN alphabet excludes I, O and Q; this catches any full 17-character VIN-shaped token.

patterns.name: email-address
patterns.note: Any email address, including masked-looking local parts with a real domain.

patterns.name: phone-number
patterns.note: International/local phone-number shape. Review any false positive against a safe fixture.

patterns.name: psi-value
patterns.note: Tyre pressure value; PSI/tread measurement data is out of scope for the public report.

patterns.name: uae-plate-value
patterns.note: UAE plate-shaped value; plates are never public.

patterns.name: uae-area-address
patterns.note: Common precise-location area label; precise location is never public.
